title: "Configuration"

# Configuration {#sec-configuration}

AEE registers all settings with `CBA_fnc_addSetting`. They appear under
the per-addon categories in the CBA Settings menu. Settings marked
*global* must match across all clients in a multiplayer session.

114 settings across 22 categories:

## AEE Atmos

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_atmos_microburstTempThreshold` | SLIDER | 28 | true | Surface temperature above which microburst conditions can form |
| `aee_atmos_microburstChance` | SLIDER | 0.01 | true | Probability of a microburst per tick when all trigger conditions hold |
| `aee_atmos_microburstDuration` | SLIDER | 12 | true | Duration of a microburst in simulation ticks |
| `aee_atmos_microburstGustMax` | SLIDER | 36 | true | Ceiling of the damaging-gust wind speed in metres per second |
| `aee_atmos_lightningConvectionTemp` | SLIDER | 25 | true | Surface temperature above which convective potential is considered high |
| `aee_atmos_lightningStrikeChance` | SLIDER | 0.05 | true | Probability of a lightning strike per tick at maximum risk |
| `aee_atmos_icingShedRate` | SLIDER | 0.9 | true | Fraction of accreted ice removed per tick while shedding conditions hold |
| `aee_atmos_maxIceMass` | SLIDER | 100 | true | Ice mass in kilograms that equals full airframe icing severity |
| `aee_atmos_radFogRampRate` | SLIDER | 0.1 | true | Radiational-fog density added per tick on clear calm moist nights |
| `aee_atmos_maxFogDensity` | SLIDER | 0.8 | true | Ceiling for the fog density value applied to the engine |

## AEE Real Weather

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_compat_realweather_enabled` | CHECKBOX | false | true | Enable real-weather mode. Reads weather.json from the mission folder and overrides AEE's simulated state. |

## AEE

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_enabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Master switch for the AEE environment simulation module |
| `aee_core_updateInterval` | SLIDER | 5 | true | Simulation update interval in seconds (lower = more frequent updates) |
| `aee_core_referenceAltitude` | SLIDER | 0 | true | Override reference altitude (m MSL) for station pressure calculations. 0 = auto-detect from unit position |
| `aee_core_clothingInsulation` | SLIDER | 1.0 | true | Multiplier for clothing insulation. Higher values keep the soldier warmer in cold conditions |
| `aee_core_diagnostic` | CHECKBOX | false | false | Enable verbose diagnostic logging (diag_log) for environment state changes |

## AEE → Thermal

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_tempLapseRateEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable elevation-based temperature lapse rate (standard atmosphere ~6.5 °C/km) |
| `aee_core_tempLapseRate` | SLIDER | 6.5 | true | Temperature lapse rate in °C per 1000 m (default: 6.5 °C/km, ICAO standard) |
| `aee_core_tempDiurnalEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable diurnal temperature variation based on solar elevation angle |

## AEE → Atmosphere

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_windEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable dynamic wind simulation with terrain and thermal influences |
| `aee_core_windTerrainInfluence` | SLIDER | 0.6 | true | Strength of terrain (ridge channelling, valley funnelling) on wind vectors (0..1) |
| `aee_core_windGustFrequency` | SLIDER | 0.3 | true | Relative frequency of gust events (0 = calm, 1 = very gusty) |
| `aee_core_humidityEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable relative-humidity tracking and condensation/precipitation calculations |
| `aee_core_precipOrographicEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable orographic-lifting precipitation enhancement on windward slopes |
| `aee_core_airDensityEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Calculate density altitude and true air density using temperature, pressure, and humidity corrections |
| `aee_core_icaoReferenceAlt` | SLIDER | 0 | true | Reference altitude (m MSL) for the ICAO standard atmosphere baseline |

## AEE → Biome

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_biomeEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Use Köppen climate classification to differentiate biome types and their weather characteristics |
| `aee_core_biomeTransitionRadius` | SLIDER | 5000 | true | Smoothing radius (m) for biome boundary transitions to avoid hard climatic edges |

## AEE → Microclimate

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_microclimateRadius` | SLIDER | 200 | true | Radius (m) for local terrain and vegetation microclimate effects (valley cool-air pooling, forest canopy) |
| `aee_core_urbanHeatIsland` | SLIDER | 0.5 | true | Magnitude of urban heat-island temperature boost in built-up areas (0 = none, 1 = full) |

## AEE → Mobility

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_mudAccretionEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable mud build-up on vehicle wheels/tracks when driving on muddy terrain |
| `aee_core_enginePowerDegradationEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Reduce ground-vehicle engine power in hot+high conditions using density-altitude derating (piston + turbo models); sets QGVAR(enginePowerModifier) and QGVAR(engineTurboModifier) |

## AEE → Radio

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_radioPropagationEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Compute radio link quality from the Friis path loss with atmospheric ducting and HF ionospheric absorption; sets QGVAR(radioPropagationIndex) |

## AEE → Optics

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_opticsEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable thermal contrast, mirage/heat haze, smoke dispersal persistence, precipitation visibility reduction, and solar glare from low-elevation sun |

## AEE → Environmental

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_hydrologyEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable snow accumulation/melt and drifting, flash flood risk in arid terrain after heavy rain, and freeze-thaw state cycling with hysteresis |
| `aee_core_environmentalEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable biological ambient sound intensity, scent dispersion vector, sea state (Beaufort/wave height), and magnetic compass deviation |

## AEE → Atmos

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_atmosphericEventsEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable lightning strike risk, severe weather (sandstorm, blizzard, dust devil), microburst downdrafts, low-level turbulence, and avalanche risk in mountain terrain |

## AEE → Physiology

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aee_core_physiologyEnabled` | CHECKBOX | true | true | Enable heat stress, WBGT, wind chill, dehydration, hypoxia, UV index, and scent dispersion |

| Setting | Type | Default | Global | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
